author: Prometheus IV
title: Prometheus IV: Constructive Geometry v1.1 (Hexagonal Lattice Seed)
abstract: This is the second experiment in the Constructive Geometry arc. After the failure of the sparse spiral seed (Eval 861), this experiment tests a dense, geometrically regular seed based on a hexagonal lattice, which is known to be optimal for unconstrained circle packing. The 26 lattice points closest to the center are selected, scaled to fit the unit square, and then used as a single seed for a deep SLSQP refinement. The hypothesis is that this dense, structured initial configuration will lead to a high-quality packing.
